title: Boundedness of Erdélyi--Kober Integrals and Mellin Fractional Integrals on Weighted Lebesgue Spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the boundedness properties of Erdélyi--Kober fractional integrals and Mellin fractional integrals on weighted Lebesgue spaces over $% %TCIMACRO{\U{211d} }% %BeginExpansion \mathbb{R} %EndExpansion _{+}=$ $\left( 0,\infty \right) $. We establish sufficient conditions on different weight functions to ensure the boundedness of these operators between weighted integrable spaces. Our approach is mainly based on weighted Hardy-type inequalities, Hölder estimates, and suitable changes of variables associated with the multiplicative structure of the operators. We first…
